description.en: Modular Framer sections and production templates engineered for web designers.
description.zh: 专为网页设计师与创意工程师打造的模块化 Framer 动效区块与整页模版。

content.en: Frameblox is an extensive library of modular Framer sections, smart components, and visual layouts built for digital designers and startup founders. With slick micro-interactions and pre-configured responsive layouts, it streamlines high-end web page creation.
content.zh: Frameblox 是专为数字产品设计师与创意工程师打造的模块化 Framer 区块库。全库收录数十款带有精心调校动效与自适应排版的现代 Hero、功能网格与交互导航，让无代码或低代码构建高水准展示站点变得极其敏捷。
